data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2024 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterwolgast issued an income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024, dated 20 November 2026, setting the income tax at €3,998.00 against €4,431.00 of wage tax already withheld, resulting in a refund of €433.00 to be paid to the taxpayer's account.
data.explanation: This letter from the Finanzamt Musterwolgast (tax office) is the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024. It fixed the tax at €3,998.00, which is lower than the €4,431.00 wage tax already withheld from salary, so there is a refund of €433.00 due to be paid into the bank account named in the letter. No late-filing surcharge was charged because the return resulted in a refund. If you think the figures are wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt Musterwolgast; the app shows the deadline by which it must arrive. If no objection is filed by then, the assessment becomes final. No action is otherwise required to receive the refund.

remedy.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterwolgast ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.

data.tax_note: This is the final income tax assessment for 2024; it fixes the tax liability and the resulting refund, so it should be kept together with the tax records for that year.
